mapper.sql: id, name, type, value, min_amount, total_count, remain_count, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM coupon WHERE status = 1 AND remain_count > 0 AND NOW() BETWEEN start_time AND end_time ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM coupon ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (name, type, value, min_amount, total_count, remain_count, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{value}, #{minAmount}, #{totalCount}, #{remainCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET remain_count = remain_count - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND remain_count > 0
UPDATE coupon SET remain_count = remain_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE coupon SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
